note: Descriptive before/after results from official evaluations. Charge levels, eras and metrics differ, so these are not directly comparable. Source IDs refer to research/sources.csv.

cases.design: Area charge south of 60th St; cars US$9 peak, once per day; trucks per entry; taxis and ride-hail per trip

traffic.label: UNVERIFIED (MTA PDF blocked); −8% to −14% per CBC

money.text: US$700.5M tolls, US$139.2M costs, US$562.0M net (2025, preliminary)
money.label: OBSERVED (REPORT)

cases.transit: Revenue bonded to a US$15B transit capital plan; no major service boost before launch.
cases.struggle: A decade-plus political fight: 2008 defeat, 2024 pause, toll cut from $15 to $9, federal termination attempt.
cases.worked: Revenue above projection; modern plate tolling at about 20% operating cost.
cases.didnt: Traffic bunched at the 5 a.m./9 p.m. rate change; speed gains disputed.
cases.toronto: Manhattan's rivers give it natural choke points; Toronto's north and west edges are open grid.

cases.design: Flat daily charge (£5 at launch, £18 in 2026), weekdays 07:00–18:00, camera enforcement

traffic.text: Cars entering −33%; all 4+ wheel vehicles −18% (2003 vs 2002)
traffic.label: OBSERVED (REPORT)

speed.text: Congestion −30% in 2003, eroding to −8% by 2006 as road space was reallocated
speed.label: OBSERVED (REPORT)

money.text: Operating cost 76% of revenue in year one; net £137M in 2007/08, 27% of revenue from penalties
money.label: OBSERVED (REPORT)

cases.transit: About +23% bus service at launch; morning-peak bus passengers +38%. Net revenue must go to transport by law.
cases.struggle: High early operating costs and contractor problems; the Western Extension was reversed in 2011.
cases.worked: Large, lasting car reduction; bus reliability improved by about 30%.
cases.didnt: Delay crept back once freed road space was given to other uses and roadworks.
cases.toronto: Track traffic volume and delay separately, and decide in advance what the freed road space is for.

cases.design: Cordon charged per crossing by time of day with a daily cap; a national tax

traffic.text: Cordon crossings −22% in the trial; about −20% sustained for a decade
traffic.label: OBSERVED (REPORT) / ESTIMATED

money.text: System about €200M including the first year; operating cost €22M in year two
money.label: OBSERVED (REPORT)

cases.transit: Bus service added before launch (+197 buses, new lines); about +4.5 points of transit use attributable to the charge.
cases.struggle: 55% of residents opposed it before the trial; procurement litigation.
cases.worked: Trial → referendum → permanent: people saw the benefit, support flipped to 53%, and the city voted yes.
cases.didnt: Suburbs voted 40% yes; high startup cost.
cases.toronto: The closest process model: senior-government legislation was needed, as it now is in Ontario.

cases.design: Paper day licence (S$3) to enter a ~500 ha zone in the morning peak

speed.text: Zone speeds up; ring road about 20% slower
speed.label: ESTIMATED

money.text: Revenue was not the objective; cost data not found
money.label: UNVERIFIED

cases.transit: Park-and-ride (10,000 spaces) largely unused; regular buses absorbed the shift.
cases.struggle: Traffic surged just before the start time (+23%), forcing longer hours within weeks.
cases.worked: Very large peak reduction; car pooling; cheap to run.
cases.didnt: Morning-only pricing barely touched the evening peak; bypass congestion.
cases.toronto: Price the shoulder hours and the bypasses from day one. A different era, so not a magnitude guide.

cases.design: Electronic, per gantry pass, no daily cap; rates reviewed quarterly against speed targets

traffic.text: Expressways −15%; zone −16% (on top of the existing scheme)
traffic.label: OBSERVED (REPORT)

money.text: Capital S$197M; operating about S$25M/yr; revenue about S$144M (2008–09)
money.label: OBSERVED (REPORT)

cases.transit: No transit package at launch; long-run transit growth came from rail building and the car-ownership quota.
cases.struggle: Revenue opacity; privacy and cost questions for the satellite-based upgrade.
cases.worked: A published formula makes rate changes routine and uncontroversial.
cases.didnt: No verified shift to transit in year one.
cases.toronto: Publish a rate-adjustment rule. Not a model for funding transit.
